_readme: Overlay for the built-in defaults. Loaded automatically from the working
directory as element.config.json; point elsewhere with --config <path>.
It is merged over the defaults, so you only list what you want to change.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the scanner and exist as notes.
A bad JSON parse is reported and the file is skipped, never fatal.
_noise: The main marks filter. cursor:pointer inherits and DOMSnapshot marks
descendants clickable, so every <svg>/wrapper <div> inside a button
otherwise scores as interactive and stacks its own box on the same
pixels. Set enabled=false to see the raw unfiltered set.
_signals: What counts as interactive. cursor_pointer is the loosest and the usual
cause of over-marking on app-style sites; turn it off per host below.
focusable is off by default because it marks a lot of scroll containers.
_limits: max_elements caps how many get numbered; the overflow stays in the tree
as plain text. Raise min_width/min_height to drop hairline hit targets.
_occlusion: Hides things covered by a large overlay (cookie banners, modals).
min_occluder_viewport_fraction is the share of the viewport an element
must cover before it is allowed to occlude anything.
_cross_process_frames: Attach to out-of-process iframes (ads, embedded players, payment forms).
Costs one extra snapshot + AX tree per frame. Set false for a faster scan
when you do not care about iframe contents.
_hosts: Per-host overrides, merged over everything above when the page host
matches exactly or is a subdomain. Add your own as needed.
